source.title: Raman spectroscopy in microfluidic chips reveals hyphal scale stress-associated metabolic responses in filamentous soil fungi
source.reuse_rights: verify exact article and external source data terms before reuse

modalities.name: stable-isotope-probing spontaneous Raman
caveats: spectral intensity is not a flux without calibration
repeated laser exposure may damage hyphae

modalities.name: stimulated Raman scattering
caveats: higher speed/sensitivity in the study; chip transparency and sterility improvements remain future requirements

experimental_context.label: deuterated glucose
reported_effects: Cu reduced glucose metabolic activity and growth
Cu-associated cytochrome-c Raman signal was reduced
thin exploratory hyphae and Cu-stressed hyphae were more vulnerable to repeated spontaneous Raman exposure
SRS localized uptaken glucose near inner hyphal edges
experimental_context.photodamage: reported; cumulative effects under repeated irradiation can include cytoplasm spillage, reduced growth and growth arrest

rules: spectral band intensity is not elemental flux without calibration
deuterated-glucose uptake is not plant-to-plant transfer
cytochrome-c spectral change is not a viability label
spontaneous Raman and SRS are different acquisition modalities
incident laser energy is not absorbed dose without optical/spot geometry
every repeated exposure to the same ROI is part of experimental history
local hyphal metabolism does not imply whole-network resource allocation

proposed_targets_not_results.reproduce: source-reported glucose uptake and Cu stress effects before model extension
proposed_targets_not_results.modality_separation: zero pooling of SIP-Raman and SRS measures without an explicit calibration bridge
proposed_targets_not_results.phototoxicity: predict or detect illumination-induced growth changes on held-out chips
proposed_targets_not_results.viability: zero cell-death classification from cytochrome-c Raman signal alone
proposed_targets_not_results.calibration: nominal 90/95% intervals on held-out chip/time groups when sample size supports them

claim_ceiling: Source-specific SIP-Raman/SRS observations for P. cf. subviscida under published microfluidic soil-chip conditions only.
